note: Lean theorems in formal/ that are about a specific board entry. The site links each from its entry page. The entries for best-n73 are the steps of the best-matrix census at n=73; that census entry does not exist until the census finishes, and until then the census-by-class pages link them.

theorems.statement: the Goethals–Seidel array of this entry is a skew-Hadamard matrix of order 476.
this entry is a quadruple with two skew and two symmetric blocks, so G-matrices of order 49 exist.
there is no Williamson quadruple of order 35. The search step is evaluated as compiled code by native_decide, so this proof also trusts the Lean compiler.

the periodic autocorrelation of a ±1 sequence of length n is congruent to n modulo 4, so u(k) = (n − PAF(k))/4 is an integer and a quadruple is four sequences whose u values sum to n at every nonzero shift.
for odd n the shifts 1 to (n − 1)/2 suffice, the range every census loop runs over.
for best matrices of order n = r² + r + 1 the symmetric sequence has row sum ±(2r + 1), which fixes the number of entries −1 in D.
a multiplier applied to all four sequences keeps a best quadruple, so D can be taken least in its multiplier orbit.

reversing the first skew sequence keeps a best quadruple; with negating D and permuting the skew sequences (IsBest.neg_d, IsBest.swap_ab, IsBest.swap_bc in the same file) these are the moves behind the normalizations of the census.
the power spectral density of D is at most 4n − 3 at every character, the ceiling on the D rows.
the power spectral density of A is at most 4n − 2 minus that of D, the ceiling on the A rows and on the pairs.
the largest of the three skew spectra at a character is at least (4n − PSD of D)/3, which lets A be the skew row that is largest at the character where D is least.
the stage-1 parity equations of the two unknown skew sequences: their pattern t satisfies M1 t = r with r(k) = 1 + u_A(k) + u_D(k) modulo 2.
the exact stage-2 identity for a given pattern, from which the stage-2 system follows.
the stage-2 equation in the bit-coded form best_hkt2.c builds, so every best quadruple solves the program's stage-2 system for its pattern.
